					<div class="wpb-content-wrapper"><div class="qodef-row-grid-section-wrapper qodef-disabled-bg-image-bellow-1024"  style="background-image: url(https://urlasurfhouse.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/p2-img-5.png);background-position: bottom center"><div class="qodef-row-grid-section"><div class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid vc_custom_1637093604333" ><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="qodef-elements-holder   qodef-one-column  qodef-responsive-mode-768 " ><div class="qodef-eh-item    "  data-item-class="qodef-eh-custom-4205" data-1400-1600="59px 21% 0 0" data-1025-1399="22px 8% 0 0" data-769-1024="20px 4% 50px 0" data-681-768="20px 91px 50px 0" data-680="30px 0px 40px 0">
	<div class="qodef-eh-item-inner">
		<div class="qodef-eh-item-content qodef-eh-custom-4205" style="padding: 70px 11% 0 0">
			<div class="qodef-section-title-holder  " >
	<div class="qodef-st-inner">
                    <span class="qodef-st-background-text" style="text-align: left">kite</span>
        					<h2 class="qodef-st-title" >
				Kitesurfing			</h2>
		                        <span class="qodef-st-caption" >Urla Surf House is here to welcome you on the beach in Gülbahçe, Urla, Turkey. In front of our kitesurf center you will find a huge lagoon with perfect flat and shallow water. Ideal for free-riding but also world-class spot for freestyle or foiling just upwind of the lagoon.</span>
        					<p class="qodef-st-text" >
				Urla Surf House quickly became a worldwide famous spot in the professional kitesurfing community, hosting big names like Aaron Hadlow, Ruben Lenten or Ewan Jaspen, but now it’s time for you to discover this magical place. Straight downwind of the free-ride area (which is in front of our center) is the big teaching area, safe and perfect for kitesurf beginners, where our professional kitesurf instructors can teach you according to international standards. We take you out in the best conditions, according to your needs, in order to maximize your kitesurf learning experience! In a little upwind we have our slider park, the only kite park open and free for everybody in all Europe. Just next to it is the huge bay perfect for foiling, and across the lagoon you will find the “Secret Spot”, famous for its beautiful turquoise and flat water.			</p>
					</div>
</div>		</div>

				book your spot			</h2>

                    <div id="text-4" class="widget qodef-footer-column-2 widget_text"><div class="qodef-widget-title-holder"><h3 class="qodef-widget-title">ABOUT</h3></div>			<div class="textwidget"><p>Urla Surf House is a concept based around surf culture taken from years of travelling around the world.</p>
<hr />
<p>ℹ️ Due to our current physical conditions, our hotel is not fully suitable for accommodating guests with disabilities.  We are working on the necessary improvements to provide better accessibility in the future.</p>
<hr />
<p>ℹ️ Otelimiz, mevcut fiziksel koşullar nedeniyle engelli misafirlerimizin konaklamasına tam olarak uygun değildir.<br />
Sizlere daha iyi hizmet verebilmek adına gerekli iyileştirmeler için çalışmalarımız devam etmektedir.</p>
</div>
